title: Hearty Smoky Monsoon French Vegetable Alsatian Tart
description: A unique Alsatian-inspired tart featuring the savory flavors of ssamjang and the sweetness of caramelized onions. Perfect for a light dinner or snack.
instructions: Roll out puff pastry on a lightly floured surface to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Transfer the pastry to a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
In a small bowl, mix together ssamjang and caramelized onions. Spread the mixture evenly over the pastry, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Sprinkle monsoon cheese and thyme over the onion mixture.
Brush the edges of the pastry with egg for a golden glaze.
Bake the tart for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the filling is heated through.
Remove the tart from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
